reviews.comment: I put in a new video card as well as this processor and the computer is still dead. It is still a work in progress.
reviews.author: Eric L.

reviews.title: Good Product; misleading seller
reviews.comment: This CPU works as advertised but there is no mention of it what shape you will get it.  There should be an actual picture of the product you are buying instead of a stock photo.  Don't be fooled...you won't get a nice Intel box like the pictures.  Actually, if you buy this item straight from a computer store it will come with a cpu fan as well as the correct documentation.  This came to me wrapped in foam and rubber banded.  In addition they didn't even clean it off good because there was still thermal paste on the top and in the cracks...Buy this CPU but buy it from somewhere else!~
reviews.author: B. Pittman
